listings.name: Texas Bass Co.
listings.title: Texas Bass Co T-Shirt, Largemouth Bass Fishing Graphic Tee, Vintage Texas Angler Shirt
listings.subject: a largemouth bass launching from splashing water, reeds and lakeside greenery
listings.alt: Large illustrated largemouth bass rising through water and reeds over TEXAS BASS CO lettering.
listings.description:
Texas Bass Co. is an original Texas Defined fishing illustration featuring a largemouth bass launching from splashing water, reeds and lakeside greenery. The naturally shaped artwork is designed to stand on its own without a solid rectangular background or travel-poster frame.

A gift idea for anglers, lake-weekend regulars, and anyone who likes Texas water and outdoor traditions. Pair it with a fishing trip, tackle-shop stop, or a quiet morning at the lake or coast.

This shirt is intended to be printed on demand by a disclosed production partner. Exact fabric, fit, colors, sizes, care instructions, processing time, shipping charges and delivery estimate must be taken from the validated product and variants before the listing goes live. This illustration does not imply sponsorship by any lake, fishing club, tournament, tackle company or government agency.
